reply_text:
I've replied to Ilse in her DM to confirm that from now on she uses Bay 30 for Quarrendon Freight Lines pickups. She said no action was needed, so I didn't change anything else.

- **The note needs confirming.** I saved it in the memory brain, but the brain flagged it as reading like a standing instruction. It's stored but won't be active until the brain owner confirms it (`gbrain trust confirm f1`). I told Ilse it's saved but may not come up automatically yet, and asked her to remind me if it doesn't.
- **Others may be able to see it.** The save came back marked "world", so other people who use the brain may be able to look it up, not just Ilse. I've told her I'll only use it in her own conversations and won't pass it on. If it should be private to her, the brain owner may want to change that.
- **Nothing conflicting on record.** Before saving, I looked in the brain for an earlier dock preference of hers and found none. The brain is running on keyword search only, so that check isn't conclusive.
